hook: Your first $10,000 is the hardest money you'll ever save, and every $10,000 after it comes faster. In this video I explain the $10,000 rule from three angles: the numbers (milestones, the crossover point, inflation and debt), the psychology that decides whether you reach it and keep it, and a simple playbook to get there and repeat it.
